title: edna2dwc: convert eDNA and metabarcoding data into Darwin Core Archives
description: edna2dwc converts eDNA and metabarcoding data into Darwin Core Archives for GBIF and OBIS. It ships as a Python command-line tool and an AI agent skill, convert-edna-to-dwc. Each conversion writes the archive alongside a bundle that replays it.
notes: Built by Intertidal Agency with The Data Patch and DrivenData, with a grant from The Schmidt Family Foundation.
